description: Step 3 - single-subject parcellation EM. All three variants supported with per-entry applies_to_variants gating.
source_note: `source` fields name the file owning the field's authoritative default. Line numbers are intentionally omitted — they drift on every reformat and the file/symbol name is the stable contract.
range_policy: advisory — `min`/`max` fields are UI hints documenting the values authors have validated; the parser/validator enforces only positivity (numeric fields) and enum membership (enum fields). Out-of-range-but-positive values are accepted at parse time.

entries.notes: gpu_full recommended default GPU backend (fused unpack+normalize for bitpacked BOLD). gpu_sparse: opt-in candidate-set EM on the theta support, ~10x faster than gpu_full, gMSHBM/dMSHBM only, requires bold_inputs.json seed_mesh='fsaverage3' (the packed-BOLD kernels cap ceil(D/8) at 256); validated against the stock-MATLAB reference on the 10-subject YS cohort (see docs/step3_sparse_design.md).
Literal default is null; Step3Config.__post_init__ resolves it to 15.0 (gMSHBM), 0.0 (cMSHBM); dMSHBM never reads it. Explicit float overrides the variant default.

entries.description: EM convergence tolerance (shared across the 4 nested loops).

entries.notes: dMSHBM has no comp_iter wrap (flat lambda-loop).
